Variant Multiclass.SpecialQuality
[Not Implemented]A character who chooses oracle as her secondary class gains the following secondary class features.
&nl;Mystery: At 1st level, she must select a mystery. She never qualifies for the Extra Revelation feat.
&nl;Curse: At 1st level, she must select a curse. She gains all effects of the curse, treating her effective oracle level as equal to 1/2 her character level.

&nl;Revelation: At 3rd level, she gains one of the following revelations from the list of those available to her mystery as an oracle of her character level - 6 (minimum 1). She must have an effective oracle level high enough to select the revelation.
&nl;Battle: Battlecry, battlefield clarity, combat healer, iron skin, resiliency, skill at arms, surprising charge, war sight.
&nl;Bones: Armor of bones, bleeding wounds, death's touch, near death, raise the dead, resist life, soul siphon, spirit walk, undead servitude, voice of the grave.
&nl;Flame: Burning magic, fire breath, form of flame, gaze of flames, heat aura, molten skin, touch of flame, wings of fire.
&nl;Heavens: Coat of many stars, dweller in darkness, guiding star, interstellar void, lure of the heavens, mantle of moonlight, spray of shooting stars, star chart.
&nl;Life: Channel, delay aff liction, energy body, enhanced cures, healing hands, life link, lifesense, safe curing, spirit boost.
&nl;Lore: Arcane archivist, automatic writing, brain drain, mental acuity, spontaneous symbology, think on it, whirlwind lesson.
&nl;Nature: Erosion touch, life leach, natural divination, speak with animals, spirit of nature, transcendental bond, undo artifice.
&nl;Stone: Acid skin, clobbering strike, crystal sight, earth glide, mighty pebble, rock throwing, shard explosion, steelbreaker skin, touch of acid.
&nl;Waves: Blizzard, fluid nature, fluid travel, freezing spells, ice armor, icy skin, punitive transformation, water form, water sight, wintry touch.
&nl;Wind: Air barrier, gaseous form, invisibility, lightning breath, spark skin, thunderburst, touch of electricity, vortex spells, wind sight, wings of air.

&nl;Orison: At 7th level, if she has a Charisma score of 10 or higher, she chooses an oracle orison to cast as a spell-like ability at will. She uses her character level as the caster level and Charisma as the orison's key ability score.
&nl;Curse Focus: At 11th level, she adds 5 to her effective oracle level for the purposes of determining her curse's effects.
&nl;Improved Revelation: At 15th level, she gains one additional revelation.
&nl;Greater Revelation: At 19th level, she gains one additional revelation.
